validation.detail: 独立 Dial K130 官方 UIFlow2 同 guest 已验证显示、触摸、GPIO42 按键和 RTC；原 RotaryIRQ 延迟回调丢中间状态，50ms 慢输入点不作为修复。旋钮、WS1850S、蜂鸣器与更广行为仍开放。

blockers: Device-local display, touch, GPIO42 BtnA and RTC passed. Deferred original Python GPIO callbacks can read identical current pin states and lose rotary steps; the 50ms operating point is not a fix. WS1850S, buzzer and broader peripheral behavior remain open.
